launch_timing: A later G10-free CPU preparation window; nonblocking shared lock, no queue or automatic retry.
limit_interpretation: 24 GiB is an upper ceiling, not a measured or projected dataset size. Tar stream is capped per chunk; aggregate staging files are sampled and may transiently overshoot.
1 MiB stream buffers; inherited 2 GiB address-space cap is per process, not an aggregate RSS guarantee. Host minimum16 GiB available memory is sampled.
Checksum pacing and rsync bandwidth caps are software pacing, not strict total block-I/O quotas; metadata traffic and source re-reads remain.

At ceiling, five32 MiB/s-equivalent read/write passes plus16 MiB/s transfer are about90 minutes of idealized streaming; metadata/9p/fsync overhead unmeasured. Four hours is a failure bound, not a completion promise.
Stage includes original inventory, tar creation, all-member content verification, local digest, transfer, external readback digest and final source-stat verification; no preliminary size traversal.

source_scope.includes: Every original directory/file under the source, including top-level derive/mix summaries and shard provenance. Symlinks/special/hard-linked regular files refuse under unchanged original admission.

source_identity_scope: Root metadata and two small original summaries pinned prospectively. Complete per-file source identities and hashes are streamed progressively during this useful archive operation; no claim of prevalidated full-tree identity.
failure: Preserve source, inventory and partial staging/external data. Existing attempt or archive refuses. Rsync retains partial bytes, but this operator does not automatically resume/adopt them.
success: Original member names/types/modes/uid/gid/mtime, contents and source stability verified, external archive readback SHA equals local SHA. Source retained. Only verified local staging tar may be removed by inherited helper; metadata receipts remain. ACL/xattrs captured by tar but not independently compared.
required_outer_invocation: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 14370s python3 run_registered.py --plan-sha256 PLAN_SHA --deadline D; D is invocation start+14400 and shared by every child. Parent must capture the outer exit; wrapper cannot self-certify a killed process.
